# Multimodal Models {#sec-multimodal}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="false"}
**Chapter status: skeleton.** Port from the CME 295-based Multimodal LLMs
material.
:::

**Learning objectives.** After this chapter you can:

- explain how images become tokens (patch embeddings) and join the same sequence as text;
- describe contrastive vision–language pretraining and what it buys;
- scope realistic industrial use cases: documents, dashboards, defect images;
- anticipate multimodal-specific failure modes (hallucinated detail, OCR limits).
